item.title: Morning Brief: New Video Emerges in Alex Pretti Minneapolis Shooting, Starmer Visits China Amid Alliance Strains, Dollar Slides as Markets Price Rising Risk
item.description: Newly released video footage from Minneapolis has added new context to the fatal shooting of Alex Pretti, complicating earlier official accounts of the incident. Abroad, UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer has begun a high-profile visit to China as Western alliances show signs of strain and governments reassess diplomatic engagement. In markets, the U.S. dollar weakened further as investors reacted to mounting economic and political uncertainty, driving increased volatility across global currencies.
